remarks: Welcome to 72 Village Walk, a delightful end-unit townhouse located in the heart of Wilton. This home offers the perfect combination of convenience, comfort, and privacy, just steps from Wilton Library, shopping, restaurants, the Metro-North station, and more. The main floor boasts a bright and open living/dining area with large windows that fill the space with natural light. A spacious bedroom on this level is conveniently located next to a full bathroom, while the updated kitchen provides ample storage and counter space. Step out to the private deck, where you can enjoy serene views of a peaceful brook and mature plantings - a great spot to start your day or relax outdoors. Upstairs, the master suite offers generous closet space and an ensuite bathroom. Additional highlights include in-unit laundry, an attached garage, and access to the complex's beautiful in-ground pool - perfect for enjoying the summer months. Situated within walking distance of Wilton's many amenities and part of an award-winning school district, this property provides an ideal location for comfortable living.
